## Summary

The project's historical security posture is narrow but acute: a single high-severity Path Traversal vulnerability was fixed in server.go, enabling arbitrary file read via os.ReadFile. The fix introduced path canonicalization and traversal-sequence rejection, indicating the core risk surface is any file-serving or file-loading path. With only one fixed issue and no published CVEs, the security context is minimal, but the pattern suggests file access operations deserve rigorous path-validation guards across all entry points. Future development must treat any new file read or write sink as a high-risk variant of this historical flaw.
